（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
No... 5/5
14/8/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 12th 191^8
Sir,
It is reported that three representatives of the
Manchu Restoration Party have been in Woosung since
10th instant negotiating with Deputy Military Governor
Lu Yoong Ziang.
In consequence of instructions from the Central
Government to make arrangements to send a regiment
of cavalry to Manchuria, General Yang has ordered
the 4th cavalry regiment at present stationed in
Sungkiang to hold itself in readiness to depart
for that place.
Eight Arsenal mechanics left for Hangchow
this morning.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities
will test guns to-day.
Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
编号…… 5/5
16年8月14日。
上海公共租界工部局。
191^8年8月12日
先生：
据报，满清复辟党三名代表自本月10日起一直在吴淞，与副督军卢永祥进行谈判。
鉴于中央政府已下达指令，要求安排派遣一个骑兵团前往满洲，杨将军已命令目前驻防松江的第四骑兵团做好出发前往该地的准备。
兵工厂八名技工于今晨启程前往杭州。
据报，兵工厂当局将于今日测试枪支。
您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席探长。
警务处总监。
